"""Continue only the verified missing V163 calls after a terminal disk-guard failure."""
import os
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1'
training=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(training)
old=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json');assert old['status']=='failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry'
assert not live(old['owner']) and not live(old['child_owner'])
sources=read(root/'review-continuation-sources-v2.json')
assert ref(sources['adoption']['path'])==sources['adoption']
adoption=read(sources['adoption']['path']);assert adoption['adopted_head_calls']==268
assert read(root/'review-checkpoint-readiness-v1.json')['finite_Adam_states_at1000']==93
assert not live(read(root/'status-v1.json')['owner'])
assert psutil.virtual_memory().available>52*2**30
assert shutil.disk_usage(repo).free>(58+.25+.5)*2**30
assert shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free>148.5*2**30+training['expected_new_quality_bytes_external']+training['expected_phase_removal_bytes']
post=root/'postprocess-v2'
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'src']),
    OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1',CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8')
prior=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')
plan={'root':str(root),'training_plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),'design':ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),
    'retained_native_collections':prior['retained_native_collections'],
    'inputs':[ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),ref(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'),
        ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),ref(root/'review-adoption-v2.json'),ref(root/'review-continuation-sources-v2.json'),
        ref(root/'review-checkpoint-readiness-v1.json'),ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),
        *[adoption[k] for k in ['original_forward_journal','original_observation_journal','original_export']],
        *prior['retained_native_collections'].values()],
    'frozen_files':sources['frozen_files'],'controller':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Explicit continuation:268 verified prior calls+3020 missing calls=3288 main review calls,no repeated call. Original reviewer/queue terminal with1 scientific stage failure;training never restarted. Identical trained weights/frozen89 neural modules/data/822 cases/four endpoints/displays. Runtime local reserve58GiB with.25GiB local artifact bound and.5GiB margin;external148GiB andpredictions external. Original source/logs/receipts/journals preserved. Inherited checkpoint validation93 Adam states/four strict CPU loads. Five continuation phases plus original checkpoint validation,final13 scientific owner records.'}
assert not (root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json').exists();save(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json',plan);guard(plan)
shared=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103'
command='from pathlib import Path;from score_harmonic_phase_trial import load_module;'+f'r=Path({str(shared)!r});'
command+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py","independent_late_spectral_metrics");load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
command+='import review_harmonic_phase_trial,diagnose_harmonic_phase_trial,audit_harmonic_phase_trial,render_harmonic_phase_trial;print("PASS actual continuation review/diagnostic/primary+independent metrics/render imports")'
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',command],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v2.json',{'returncode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,'command':command,'plan':ref(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json'),'new_forwards':0})
assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
(root/'postprocess-controller-v2.claim').open('x').close()
status={'status':'starting-verified-continuation','owner':{'pid':os.getpid(),'created':psutil.Process().create_time()},'completed':{},
    'original_checkpoint_validation':old['completed']['checkpoint-validation'],'original_failed_review':old['completed']['review']}
save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status)
child=None;child_owner=None
try:
    for stage,name in [('review','review_harmonic_phase_trial.py'),('phase-removal','diagnose_harmonic_phase_trial.py'),
        ('scores','score_harmonic_phase_trial.py'),('metric-audit','audit_harmonic_phase_trial.py'),('render','render_harmonic_phase_trial.py')]:
        guard(training);guard(plan)
        with (root/('postprocess-'+stage+'-v2.log')).open('x') as log:
            child=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(post/'scripts'/name),str(root)],cwd=repo,env=env,
                stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
            child_owner={'pid':child.pid,'created':psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            status.update(status='running-'+stage,stage=stage,child_owner=child_owner)
            save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status);code=child.wait()
        status['completed'][stage]={'owner':child_owner,'returncode':code};assert code==0,(stage,code)
    status['status']='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
    save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status)
except BaseException as error:
    if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
        os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM);child.wait(timeout=30)
    status.update(status='failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry',error=repr(error))
    save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status)
    raise
print(status['status'],flush=True)
